dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature fitting a parabolic spline from the dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow pixel radius at the morphological peak.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 48-degree incline relative to the horizontal body axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate convex arc radius defining the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 140 degrees at the rostrum-melon transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlight/bloom effect across the dorsal and lateral regions.
